{"@type":"ProductGroup","@context":"https://schema.org","productGroupID":"17041761","hasVariant":[{"@type":"Product","sku":"17041761","name":"Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum 80ml","description":" Carolina Herrera La Bomba is bold, radiant, and utterly unforgettable. From the very first spritz, a showstopping burst of exotic pitaya delivers a juicy thrill that electrifies the senses, setting the stage for a fragrance that demands attention.

La Bomba está diseñada para ella: una mujer vital, libre, espontánea y rebosante de energía positiva. Their journey begins in hidden bays and fjords and takes them across the endless depths of the sea to islands and countries with exotic, intense spices.Their journey defies all storms and breaks all rules.
